# Tax

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** package + api  
**Status:** shipped

## Purpose

Decides whether an issuer may charge tax on a supply at all, and only then at what rate. One set of rules, two issuers: rcln billing a clinic for its subscription, and a clinic billing a patient.

## Features

- `resolveTax()` — starts from "do we hold a registration here?", never from "what rate?", and returns NOT_REGISTERED with the reason on the document when nothing covers the place of supply
- `placeOfSupply` as an explicit input — the customer's location for a digital service (a subscription), the issuing BRANCH for a service performed at a place (a consultation)
- `tax_rules` — effective-dated rates per item tax category, carrying the LINE NAME and split behaviour so the presentation is data rather than an assumption about India
- `tax_rule_defaults` — the rate cards rcln maintains per country, INHERITED at read time and never copied into a tenant, so a published rate change reaches every clinic that has not overridden it with one INSERT
- Precedence: a tenant rule beats a platform default before specificity is considered, all-or-nothing per tax category — the clinic signs the return, and a half-inherited rate card is one nobody authored
- `rulesFor()` returns every applicable rule — a regional rule normally overrides the country-wide one, but a `stacks` rule adds to it, which is the only way Canada's federal GST + provincial PST can be billed at all
- India's CGST/SGST/IGST split is one rule with `split: INTRA_STATE_HALVES`; every other GST country prints one line, and `regionalLineName` covers UTGST
- `TaxProviderQuote` — the seam for US sales tax and EU One Stop Shop; the engine stays pure and prices from the provider's own lines, or returns PROVIDER_REQUIRED
- `UNRATED` / `PROVIDER_REQUIRED` — a category with no rule, or a regime no table can compute, charges nothing and says so rather than borrowing a rate
- `UNISSUABLE_TREATMENTS` + `isIssuable()` — the shared list so the engine and Phase 5's finalisation guard cannot drift
- `loadTaxContext()` — one read per invoice, after which pricing every line is pure

## Business rules

- [Tax may only be charged where the issuer holds a registration covering the place of supply; an empty registration set means nothing is ever taxed](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#tax may only be charged where the issuer holds a registration covering the place of supply; an empty registration set means nothing is ever taxed)
- [A clinical service is supplied at the branch that performed it, never at the patient's home address](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#a clinical service is supplied at the branch that performed it, never at the patient's home address)
- [The rate is a property of the item, not of the registration — a clinic's registration carries no standard rate at all](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#the rate is a property of the item, not of the registration — a clinic's registration carries no standard rate at all)
- [What a tax line is CALLED is a property of the rule, not of the country: Ontario prints one HST line and British Columbia prints GST plus PST](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#what a tax line is called is a property of the rule, not of the country: ontario prints one hst line and british columbia prints gst plus pst)
- [A stacked regional tax is charged on the net, never on the net plus the federal tax — that would be a tax on a tax](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#a stacked regional tax is charged on the net, never on the net plus the federal tax — that would be a tax on a tax)
- [A rate change is a new effective-dated row, never an edit, so an issued invoice stays explicable](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#a rate change is a new effective-dated row, never an edit, so an issued invoice stays explicable)
- [Removing a tax rule is an end date, never a delete — the row that priced an issued invoice is what explains it to an auditor](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#removing a tax rule is an end date, never a delete — the row that priced an issued invoice is what explains it to an auditor)
- [Only healthcare-service exemptions are seeded; goods rates vary by product within a country, so an unverified default would be wrong invisibly for every clinic in it](../BusinessRules/Tax.md#only healthcare-service exemptions are seeded; goods rates vary by product within a country, so an unverified default would be wrong invisibly for every clinic in it)

## Known limitations

- No platform console SCREEN for the defaults catalogue — the four routes exist but are curl-only until phase 7
- No tenant-facing screen or permission for a clinic's own registrations and overrides — phase 7
- The divergence warning that makes tenant-beats-platform safe needs a screen to live on, so it does not exist yet
- ⚠️ Canada is fully supported by the engine and tested, but is absent from `locale.ts`, so no clinic can select it at signup
- ⚠️ Goods are deliberately unseeded, so a clinic billing medicines gets UNRATED until it configures rates it has checked
- ⚠️ UNRATED and PROVIDER_REQUIRED lines are reported, not refused — the finalisation guard that must not ISSUE them is phase 5
- No tax provider is implemented, so US sales tax and EU cross-border consumer VAT charge nothing; the seam takes a quote but nothing fills it
- A customer tax id is always UNVALIDATED — no VIES or GSTIN validation path, so a B2B invoice cannot reach reverse charge
- Seeded defaults are a starting point with provenance, not tax advice — each needs a per-country review before billing
